alpha_beta.description: Whether to prune the search with alpha-beta, searching the best line of the previous depth first. It finds the same scores in far fewer nodes, but may choose another of several equally scored moves.
alpha_beta.title: Alpha Beta

aspiration_window.description: Initial score half-window, zero to disable aspiration.
aspiration_window.title: Aspiration Window

beetle_control.description: Elevated beetle balance, doubled over an enemy queen.
beetle_control.title: Beetle Control

depth.description: The maximum search depth in plies, or `None` to search until stopped.
depth.title: Depth

forced_move_extension.description: Search a forced move without using up depth.
forced_move_extension.title: Forced Move Extension

free_ants.description: Own minus opponent uncovered, unpinned ants after queen placement.
free_ants.title: Free Ants

late_move_reductions.description: Moves searched at full depth before later ones are scouted a ply shallower, zero for none. Needs principal variation search.
late_move_reductions.title: Late Move Reductions

material_in_hand.description: The weight of the value of the player's pieces in hand minus the opponent's.
material_in_hand.title: Material In Hand

material_on_board.description: The weight of the value of the player's pieces on the board minus the opponent's.
material_on_board.title: Material On Board

mobile_ant.description: Own minus opponent ants that can take a first step.
mobile_ant.title: Mobile Ant

mobile_beetle.description: Own minus opponent beetles that can move.

mobile_grasshopper.description: Own minus opponent grasshoppers that can move.

mobile_queen.description: Own minus opponent queens that can take a first step.
mobile_queen.title: Mobile Queen

mobile_spider.description: Own minus opponent spiders that can take a first step.
mobile_spider.title: Mobile Spider

mobility.description: The weight of the player's legal moves minus the opponent's. This term generates moves at every leaf, which makes it slow.
mobility.title: Mobility

null_move_reduction.description: Extra depth reduction of a null move at scout nodes, zero for none.
null_move_reduction.title: Null Move Reduction

pinned_material.description: Opponent minus own covered or articulation-pinned material.
pinned_material.title: Pinned Material

placement_cells.description: Own minus opponent free cells to place a piece on.
placement_cells.title: Placement Cells

positioning.description: The weight of the player's pieces next to the opponent's queen minus the opponent's pieces next to the player's queen.
positioning.title: Positioning

principal_variation_search.description: Scout later moves before a full-window search.
principal_variation_search.title: Principal Variation Search

queen_attack_ordering.description: Order moves next to the enemy queen after killers.
queen_attack_ordering.title: Queen Attack Ordering

queen_danger.description: Nonlinear queen crowding: squared occupied-neighbour counts.
queen_danger.title: Queen Danger

queen_escape.description: Legal queen escapes, excluding covered or pinned queens.
queen_escape.title: Queen Escape

queen_locked_neighbors.description: Queen neighbours its owner cannot move away.
queen_locked_neighbors.title: Queen Locked Neighbors

queen_safety.description: The weight of the occupied neighbours of the opponent's queen minus those of the player's own queen.
queen_safety.title: Queen Safety

queen_threat_extension.description: Search a ply deeper once a queen has five neighbours.
queen_threat_extension.title: Queen Threat Extension

repetition_draws.description: Score a repeat of an earlier position as a draw.

table_deeper_hits.description: Reuse table entries searched deeper than needed.
table_deeper_hits.title: Table Deeper Hits
